title: Select Track and Garage long frames trimmed (#627, #630)
summary: Two host-measured performance fixes cut long frames when stepping through courses and vehicles on a throttled phone-sized viewport.
details: Select Track (#627) rebuilt the whole Taffy layout tree for every course selection; it now retains the background and content trees and rebuilds only on structural change (paint and raster unchanged). Host Chromium, 4x CPU throttle, 390x844 DPR3 touch, three fresh contexts: changed-course layout medians 26.8-29.2 ms to 10.5-12.9 ms. Garage (#630) rebuilt identical shader and pipeline state for each new vehicle and rider; that immutable GPU setup is now shared. Slowest post-load motorcycle tasks 256/248/206 ms to 82/87/70 ms; new programs per ATV/motorcycle step 1/2 to 0/0. ATV tasks went 84/99/83 ms to 122/80/75 ms, so no ATV improvement is claimed.
limitation: Host Chromium only, no physical-phone measurements. Select Track upload samples still reach 114 ms and fresh-context tasks near half a second remain. Garage ATV builds still reach 122 ms, motorcycles 87 ms post-load, and the first fresh-process tap 613 ms (519 ms of it in AudioContext construction). No screenshots were captured.
